## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (a, foundations). This is audit backlog UX-13 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: All forms in web/clinic and web/platform-admin; Today rows; settings and registration choices. All roles, touch widths first.
Findings and reviewers: F-20, F-33 · reviewers C-01, B-20, A-17.
Rationale: Once the defaults are right, the patches are noise and the next missed patch is impossible. About 10 % of controls on touch widths are still under 44 px: native radios and checkboxes at 16 px and patient-name links 19 px tall.
Proposed UX behaviour: Part 1, the codemod, in its own pull request that merges alone: remove min-h-11 and h-11 from Input, SelectTrigger, Textarea and Button call sites in features and the console; lower the ratchet baseline to zero for that count and turn the lint rule to error. Part 2, by hand: the 26 native radios and checkboxes use ChoiceRow so the row is the target; on Today the whole visit row is the link to the patient, not the 19 px name.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 4.
Components and tokens affected: No new component. Uses the defaults and ChoiceRow from the previous ticket.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the library-defaults ticket. File ownership: part 1 touches about 90 feature files and nothing else may merge into web/clinic/src/features or web/platform-admin/src in the same window; open pull requests rebase after it (the codemod can be re-run on a branch in minutes). Track S pull requests take priority: if one is ready, it merges first and the codemod is re-run.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low for behaviour, medium for merge conflicts with work in flight; mitigated by merging alone and re-running.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Any layout change. (2) Compact density. (3) The skip link (32 by 24 px, visible only on focus) stays as it is.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given web/clinic/src and web/platform-admin/src, when the code is searched for min-h-11 or h-11 on Input, SelectTrigger, Textarea and Button, then there is no hit and the ratchet count is zero
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a feature file, when a developer adds h-11 to an Input, then pnpm -r lint fails with a message that names the library default
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the screens captured before the codemod at 1440, 1024 and 375, when they are captured again after it, then no control changed size or position
- [ ] **AC4.** Given Today, settings and registration at 1024 and 768 touch, when every control is measured, then none is under 24 px in either dimension and every radio, checkbox and patient row is at least 44 px tall as a target
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the walk-in path, when a new and a returning patient are checked in, then the counts are still at most 6 clicks for a new patient and 3 for a returning one
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the changed screens in English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- Existing J1 to J3 and feature suites stay green.
- New metric check (Playwright, real stack or mocked): no control under 24 px at 375, 768 and 1024; reuse the measuring code in docs/product-ux-audit/tools/states-measure.mjs as the reference.
- Screenshot comparison before and after for the 20 most-used screens, attached to the pull request.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low. A failed comparison means a call site relied on the patch for something else; fix that site by hand.
